segments.tha-ap454:2.3: Nibbāyiṃsu tayo aggī, labhāmi vipulaṃ sukhaṃ.
segments.tha-ap454:3.1: “Aho buddho aho dhammo, aho no satthusampadā;
segments.tha-ap454:4.1: “Tiyaggī [tidhaggī (syā. ka.), tivaggī (pī.)] nibbutā mayhaṃ, bhavā sabbe samūhatā;
segments.tha-ap454:7.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap454:9.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā morahatthiyo thero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.
